items.criterion: Use NASA.gov and locate the most relevant Artemis II mission page (or best NASA-hosted alternative if blocked)
items.description: Navigate on NASA.gov (starting from nasa.gov is acceptable) and search for “Artemis II,” then open the most relevant official Artemis II mission page (not an unrelated news article when an official mission page/hub page is available). Full credit if the agent reaches an official Artemis II mission page on NASA.gov, or if NASA.gov is inaccessible/blocked and the agent clearly reports the blocker and uses the best available NASA-hosted alternative (e.g., a NASA subdomain mirror, NASA-hosted mission hub, or NASA-hosted fact sheet) that contains the needed mission overview/crew information. Partial credit if the agent finds Artemis II information on NASA.gov but uses a less-relevant page when a clearly more relevant mission page is available. No credit if the agent relies on non-NASA sources without first attempting NASA.gov or a NASA-hosted alternative.

items.criterion: Extract planned launch date, destination, and mission duration from NASA's Mission Overview (or equivalent official section)
items.description: Using the Mission Overview section on the Artemis II mission page (or an equivalent overview section on the most relevant NASA-hosted alternative), correctly extract and report: planned launch date, destination, and mission duration. Full credit if all three items are reported accurately as stated on the NASA page. Full credit if one or more fields are not specified/are TBD on the NASA page and the agent clearly reports that. Partial credit if only 1–2 of the three details are accurately reported, or if values are slightly off but clearly tied to NASA wording. No credit if details are fabricated or taken from non-NASA sources when NASA provides them.

items.criterion: Extract Artemis II crew members from NASA's Crew section (or equivalent official crew listing)
items.description: Using the Crew section on the Artemis II mission page (or an equivalent crew listing on the most relevant NASA-hosted alternative), report the crew members. Full credit if all crew members listed on the NASA page are provided correctly. Full credit if the crew list is not present/is TBD on the NASA page and the agent clearly reports that. Partial credit if some crew are correct but one or more are missing or incorrect. No credit if crew names are invented or taken from non-NASA sources when NASA provides them.
